meta.prompt: Draft an email to my landlord about the broken heating and show it as an inline card I can edit before it goes: to, subject and body fields filled in, a tone switch between polite and firm that rewrites the body, and send and discard buttons. Sending needs a recipient and a subject, and afterwards the card shows it as sent.
meta.text:
Card w:390 gap:12 pad:16
  Text.heading "Email to landlord"
  Input "To" "landlord@example.com" =to
  Input "Subject" "Heating not working" =subject
  SegmentedButton =tone items:["Polite","Firm"] -> body=tone=="Firm"?"Hello,\n\nThe heating in my flat has not worked for over a week. This is a serious problem and I need it repaired as soon as possible. Please confirm when someone will attend.\n\nRegards":"Hello,\n\nI hope you are well. The heating in my flat stopped working about a week ago and I would be grateful if you could arrange a repair when convenient. Please let me know when someone can attend.\n\nThank you,"
  Input "Body" "Write your message" =body
  Row gap:8 end
    Button.ghost "Discard" -> to=""; subject=""; body=""; sent=false
    Button "Send" -> emit sendEmail; sent=true
  if sent
    Text.success "Sent to {to}"

state sent=false
state tone="Polite"
state body="Hello,\n\nI hope you are well. The heating in my flat stopped working about a week ago and I would be grateful if you could arrange a repair when convenient. Please let me know when someone can attend.\n\nThank you,"
